notes.title: New version 9.8.3
notes.content:
- Fixed level uploading
- Fixed deleting levels
- Character customization has been redone (to open cards you need to buy them in the store)
- Slightly changed the level selection menu

notes.title: New version 9.3
notes.content: Added deleting and editing of object code in the menu. The maximum line width in the editor has been increased to 1000. Added language selection in the settings. Lots of bug and glitch fixes. The full version of the changes is available in our discord 17Studio.
